query:
usage: code-review-graph query [-h] [--to TO] [--repo REPO] pattern target

positional arguments:
  pattern      One of: callers_of, references_to, callees_of, imports_of,
               importers_of, children_of, tests_for, inheritors_of,
               triggers_of, triggered_by, publishers_of, listeners_of,
               advises, advised_by, handlers_of, endpoints_for, consumers_of,
               file_summary, path_to
  target       Node name, qualified name, or file path

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --to TO      For path_to: the node or file to reach
  --repo REPO  Repository root (auto-detected)
search:
usage: code-review-graph search [-h]
                                [--kind {File,Class,Function,Type,Test,YamlPath,DocSection,Variable,Output,JsonPath}]
                                [--limit LIMIT] [--repo REPO]
                                query

positional arguments:
  query                 Search string

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --kind {File,Class,Function,Type,Test,YamlPath,DocSection,Variable,Output,JsonPath}
  --limit LIMIT
  --repo REPO           Repository root (auto-detected)
status:
usage: code-review-graph status [-h] [--repo REPO] [-q] [--json]
                                [--data-dir DATA_DIR]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO          Repository root (auto-detected)
  -q, --quiet          Suppress output
  --json               Output one machine-readable JSON object
  --data-dir DATA_DIR  External directory to store graph database (useful for
                       network shares)
repos:
usage: code-review-graph repos [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

usage: code-review-graph register [-h] [--alias ALIAS] path

positional arguments:

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --alias ALIAS  Short alias for the repository

usage: code-review-graph unregister [-h] path_or_alias

positional arguments:
  path_or_alias  Repository path or alias to remove

options:

options:

  --repo REPO           Repository root (auto-detected)
community:
usage: code-review-graph community [-h] (--id ID | --name NAME) [--members]
                                   [--repo REPO]

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --id ID
  --name NAME

  --repo REPO  Repository root (auto-detected)
context-history:
usage: code-review-graph context-history [-h] [--repo REPO] [--by {day,tool}]
                                         [--days DAYS] [--json]
                                         [--data-dir DATA_DIR]

Read the local context history log and print a trend. Recording is off unless
CRG_CONTEXT_HISTORY=1 is set; the log stays on this machine and holds only
token counts and tool names.

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO          Repository root (auto-detected)
  --by {day,tool}      Group by UTC day (default) or by tool
  --days DAYS          Only the last N days (default: everything in the log)
  --json               Output one machine-readable JSON object
  --data-dir DATA_DIR  Directory that holds graph.db, when it is not the
                       default
postprocess:
usage: code-review-graph postprocess [-h] [--repo REPO] [--no-flows]
                                     [--no-communities] [--no-fts]
                                     [--data-dir DATA_DIR]
                                     [--embedding-provider {local,openai,google,minimax,voyage}]
                                     [--embedding-model EMBEDDING_MODEL]
                                     [--wait]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO           Repository root (auto-detected)
  --no-flows            Skip flow detection
  --no-communities      Skip community detection
  --no-fts              Skip FTS rebuild
  --data-dir DATA_DIR   External directory to store graph database (useful for
                        network shares)
  --embedding-provider {local,openai,google,minimax,voyage}
                        Explicitly refresh an existing embedding index with
                        this provider; requires --embedding-model (default:
                        disabled)
  --embedding-model EMBEDDING_MODEL
                        Exact model for --embedding-provider. Cloud providers
                        may transmit source-derived text and incur API cost
  --wait                If a build, update or postprocess is already running
                        for this repository, wait for it to finish instead of
                        skipping.
detect-changes:
usage: code-review-graph detect-changes [-h] [--base BASE] [--brief]
                                        [--repo REPO] [--churn] [--verify]
                                        [--details SECTIONS]

options:
  -h, --help          show this help message and exit
  --base BASE         Git diff base (branch refs use their merge base with
                      HEAD; default: HEAD~1)
  --brief             Show the risk summary + Token Savings panel instead of
                      the full JSON. Read-only against the existing graph.
  --repo REPO         Repository root (auto-detected)
  --churn             Add an opt-in change-frequency term to risk scores.
                      Counts commits per file over 90 days by default; set
                      CRG_CHURN_WINDOW_DAYS to adjust.
  --verify            Calibrate the estimated savings against tiktoken's
                      cl100k_base tokenizer (the GPT-4 family tokenizer). Adds
                      a second row to the panel with the real token counts.
                      Requires `pip install tiktoken`.
  --details SECTIONS  Add bounded graph context to the JSON under 'details': a
                      comma-separated list of risk, communities, hubs,
                      coupling, impact, gaps, graph, or all. Not used with
                      --brief.
forget:
usage: code-review-graph forget [-h] [--repo REPO] [--dry-run]
                                [--data-dir DATA_DIR] [--wait]
                                PATH [PATH ...]

positional arguments:
  PATH                 Files, directories, or glob patterns to drop from the
                       graph. Paths may be absolute or relative to the
                       repository root.

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO          Repository root (auto-detected)
  --dry-run            List the files that would be forgotten without
                       modifying the graph
  --data-dir DATA_DIR  External directory to store graph database (useful for
                       network shares)
  --wait               If another write to this graph is running, wait for it
                       to finish instead of exiting without forgetting
                       anything.
wiki:
usage: code-review-graph wiki [-h] [--repo REPO] [--force]
                              [--data-dir DATA_DIR]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO          Repository root (auto-detected)
  --force              Regenerate all pages even if content unchanged
  --data-dir DATA_DIR  External directory to store graph database (useful for
                       network shares)
dead-code:
usage: code-review-graph dead-code [-h] [--kind {Function,Class}]
                                   [--file-pattern FILE_PATTERN]
                                   [--limit LIMIT] [--json] [--repo REPO]
                                   [--data-dir DATA_DIR]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --kind {Function,Class}
                        Filter by node kind
  --file-pattern FILE_PATTERN
                        Filter by file path substring
  --limit LIMIT         Maximum rows to print (0 = no limit)
  --json                Output a machine-readable JSON array
  --repo REPO           Repository root (auto-detected)
  --data-dir DATA_DIR   External directory containing the graph database
embed:
usage: code-review-graph embed [-h] [--repo REPO]
                               [--provider {local,openai,google,minimax,voyage}]
                               [--model MODEL] [--data-dir DATA_DIR] [--wait]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO           Repository root (auto-detected)
  --provider {local,openai,google,minimax,voyage}
                        Embedding provider (default: local, needs pip install
                        "code-review-graph[embeddings]")
  --model MODEL         Embedding model. For local: HuggingFace ID (default
                        all-MiniLM-L6-v2); for openai/google/minimax/voyage:
                        provider-specific model ID.
  --data-dir DATA_DIR   External directory to store graph database (useful for
                        network shares)
  --wait                If another write to this graph is running, wait for it
                        to finish instead of exiting without embedding.
hook-update:
usage: code-review-graph hook-update [-h] [--existing-only]

Hook command: update the graph of the repository that holds the edited file
named in the event read from stdin.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --existing-only  Update only a graph that exists; never build a new one.
hook-status:
usage: code-review-graph hook-status [-h]

Hook command: show graph status for the folder named in the event read from
stdin.

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
enrich:
usage: code-review-graph enrich [-h]

Hook command: add graph context to a Claude Code PreToolUse event read from
stdin.

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
